title: Why Have You Forsaken Me?

questions.question: My God, my God, why have you what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 22:1 (ESV): "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"

questions.question: Why are you so far from saving me, from the words of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 22:1 (ESV): "...Why are you so far from saving me, from the words of my groaning?"

questions.question: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by mankind and despised by the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 22:6 (ESV): "But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by mankind and despised by the people."

questions.question: They divide my garments among them, and for my clothing they cast what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 22:18 (ESV): "they divide my garments among them, and for my clothing they cast lots."

questions.question: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 22:27 (ESV): "All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the Lord,"

questions.question: Many bulls encompass me; strong bulls of where surround me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 22:12 (ESV): "Many bulls encompass me; strong bulls of Bashan surround me;"

questions.question: They open wide their mouths at me, like a ravening and roaring what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 22:13 (ESV): "they open wide their mouths at me, like a ravening and roaring lion."

questions.question: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 22:14 (ESV): "I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint;"

questions.question: My heart is like wax; it is melted within my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 22:14 (ESV): "my heart is like wax; it is melted within my breast;"

questions.question: For kingship belongs to the Lord, and he rules over the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 22:28 (ESV): "For kingship belongs to the Lord, and he rules over the nations."

questions.question: They have pierced my hands and feet; I can count all my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 22:16-17 (ESV): "...they have pierced my hands and feet— I can count all my bones—"

questions.question: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 22:20 (ESV): "Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog!"

questions.question: Save me from the mouth of the lion! You have rescued me from the horns of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 22:21 (ESV): "Save me from the mouth of the lion! You have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen!"

questions.question: Posterity shall serve him; it shall be told of the Lord to the coming what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 22:30 (ESV): "Posterity shall serve him; it shall be told of the Lord to the coming generation;"

questions.question: They shall come and proclaim his righteousness to a people yet unborn, that he has what?

key_verse_text: For kingship belongs to the Lord, and he rules over the nations.
